name: io.github.bowenerchen/cipherhub
title: CipherHUB Cryptography Toolkit
description: Production-grade cryptography toolkit with 55 MCP tools covering classical algorithms, Chinese national standards (SM2/SM3/SM4/SM9/ZUC), post-quantum (ML-KEM/ML-DSA), X.509 certificates, and CMS/COSE/CBOR structured messages.
